params.name: edLevel
params.description: Single digit code for education level applicable values are P -> primary, M -> Middle, H -> High, O -> Mixed Grades for public school type andE -> Elementary , S -> Secondary , O -> Others mixed grades for private schools

params.name: schoolType
params.description: Single digit code for schoolTypes applicable values are PRI and PUB

params.name: schoolSubType
params.description: Single digit code for schoolSubType Applicable values are C, M, A, R, I, L, P, V, U, S (i.e. Charter, Magnet, Alternative, Regular, Indian, Military, Reportable Program, Vocational, Unknown, Special Education)

params.name: gender
params.description: Single digit code for gender Applicable values are C, F, M (Coed, All Females, All Males) Applicable for Private Schools Only

params.name: assignedSchoolsOnly
params.description: Single digit code for assignedSchoolOnly applicable values are  Y/N

params.name: districtSchoolsOnly
params.description: Single digit code for districtSchoolOnly applicable values are Y/N

params.name: searchRadius
params.description: Search Radius within which schools are searched

params.name: searchRadiusUnit
params.description: Search Radius unit applicable values are feet,kilometers,miles,meters

params.name: travelTime
params.description: Travel Time based on travelMode within which schools are searched.

params.name: travelTimeUnit
params.description: Travel Time unit applicable values are minutes,hours,seconds,milliseconds

params.name: travelDistance
params.description: Travel Distance based on travelMode within which schools are searched.

params.name: travelDistanceUnit
params.description: Travel distanceUnit applicable values are feet,kilometers,miles,meters

params.name: travelMode
params.description: Travel mode Required when travelDistance or travelTime is specified. Accepted values are walking,driving
